tagline: Healthcare access, even when connectivity is limited.
services_title: Healthcare services built around your needs
step1_title: Create an account or sign in
symptom_checker_title: Check your symptoms before you book
symptom_checker_description: Describe what you are feeling. Our AI provides preliminary triage guidance without requiring an account.
symptoms_placeholder: Example: fever and cough for two days
symptom_disclaimer: AI guidance is preliminary and is not a diagnosis. For severe or life-threatening symptoms, call emergency services immediately.
page_title: Nabha Telemedicine — Accessible Healthcare, Wherever You Are
how_description: Simple access for patients and healthcare teams, with role-based services behind the scenes.
roles_description: Each user receives access based on their verified account and permissions.
patient_care_desc: Manage your healthcare information, appointments, consultations, prescriptions and follow-ups in one place.
asha_support_desc: Help community health workers register patients, record information and coordinate care from their assigned areas.
doctor_consultations_desc: Enable doctors to review patient information, conduct teleconsultations and provide digital care plans.
offline_care_desc: Continue supported workflows during limited connectivity and synchronize information when a connection becomes available.
step4_description: Supported offline workflows can continue locally and synchronize with the healthcare platform when connectivity returns.
emergency_description: Nabha Telemedicine is not a replacement for emergency medical services. For a life-threatening emergency, contact your local emergency medical service immediately.
cta_description: Create your account to access Nabha Telemedicine, or sign in if you are already registered.
footer_description: A digital healthcare platform designed to improve access to healthcare services across rural and underserved communities.
hero_description: Nabha Telemedicine helps patients and healthcare workers connect with doctors through accessible digital healthcare services—even when internet connectivity is limited.
step1_description: New users complete the appropriate registration process. Existing users securely sign in to their account.
step2_description: Your account type determines the services and information available to you.
step3_description: Book appointments, manage patient information or participate in teleconsultations according to your role.
services_description: One platform connecting patients, community health workers, doctors and healthcare administrators.
patient_role_desc: Access personal healthcare services and stay connected with your care team.
asha_role_desc: Support patients in the community and coordinate care with healthcare teams.
doctor_role_desc: Provide remote consultations and manage care for authorized patients.
